params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: The 3D graph on the home page tells everyone to hold ctrl or cmd to zoom, which means nothing on a phone or tablet.

Asked: on touch devices the line under the graph reads "Drag to turn it. Pinch to zoom."; elsewhere it stays "Drag to turn it. Hold ctrl or cmd to zoom."

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Graph instruction on touch screens says pinch to zoom
